authority.note: Sealed BEFORE src/research/evidence/context_attribution.py existed and before any holdout delta was computed (the F-083 lesson: a contract written after the driver is a description, not a pre-registration). MEASURES incremental value on the EVERY-BAR population, NOT on production's executed trades -- those are 3 trades in 47,275 XAUUSD M15 bars (results/run_20260829_005642_XAUUSD), so per-family attribution against the CRT ledger is structurally impossible and was never attempted. A family clearing this gate has shown information orthogonal to CRT state on a population production does not trade. That is rung 1 of the Authority Ladder and nothing more: it is NOT a G001 improvement, NOT permission to size, and NOT permission to enter context_attribution.promoted_families, which stays empty. AMENDMENT 2026-08-29, BEFORE any y was computed and before mt00 ran: the PRIMARY metric's definition was tightened from 'overlay inside each stratum' to 'overlay on stratum-CENTERED y, skipping strata where the context does not vary'. Two defects in the looser reading were found by the orthogonality floor (tests/research/test_context_attribution_contract.py) while it was still a planted-fixture test with no outcome data attached: uncentered y leaves a k*stratum_mean*(n_a-n_d)/n term, and a single-cell stratum is a uniform rescale rather than a contrast. This is a pre-registration correction, not a post-hoc retune -- no metrics.json existed when it was made. Recorded rather than silently applied, per E-001.

population.inclusion_rule: UNIT = one (candle, direction) pair. `unit_of_analysis` is declared `candle` because the FROZEN schema enum offers no bar_x_direction member and the schema is not loosened to fit an instance; the 2x directional fan-out is explicit here and in population_hash_inputs, and the two directions on one bar are NOT independent of each other. MEASUREMENT CORPUS = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv ONLY (47275 bars, sha256 4d73f5cebe33ec91c5312340337eb62c2cf1f49060c91c42761bf631b26aba56). Outcome surface = results/research/oracle_labels/XAUUSD_M15/labels.csv (SEM-018, 377256 units over 47157 labelled bars). PRIMARY ARM is the single declared arm (sl_geom=disp_bar, tie_break=production) -> 94314 units; labeler.py:76-79 already declares the other three as robustness, not extra shots at significance. Context surface = the BarStructureSnapshot stream (SEM-035) for the SAME corpus_sha256. JOIN is labels._pos == snapshot.bar_index, legal ONLY within one run_id and one corpus_sha256. Snapshot rows with phase=WARMUP carry no engine state and are excluded from every arm. SUCCESS GATE uses HOLDOUT units only (timestamp >= 2025-12-24 19:15:00, corpus index 37820).
population.exclusion_rule: F-086's 236-bar stride holdout is NOT this split and remains UNSPENT. CRT TRADE_OPENED rows are NOT this population (n=3; see authority.note). SEM-012 visual-CRT, SEM-026 mother-range and SEM-031 Sujan entries are different populations. opportunities.outcome is never y. WARMUP snapshot rows are excluded. Rows whose snapshot crt_state_after is null are excluded. Session and hour_of_day are OUT OF PATH (F-066: 53.36% of XAUUSD bars carry a wrong session label under broker_local).

features.point_in_time_rule: Every snapshot field is emitted AFTER CRTEngine.process_candle returns for that bar and is a function of bars <= i only: the trailing Candle window and the D1 ParentCandleBuilder are advanced incrementally in chronological order (bar_structure_snapshot.BarStructureEmitter._advance_window), and ParentCRTFeed never exposes an in-progress parent. The OUTCOME is forward-looking by construction (SEM-018 selects bars by their future); the CONTEXT is not. Session and hour_of_day are OUT OF PATH.

crt_state_after.formula_ref: engine.state.current_state.name AFTER process_candle, recorded per bar

agree_parent_crt.formula_ref: parent_bias == 'LONG' and side == 'long', or parent_bias == 'SHORT' and side == 'short'; NONE excluded from both cells

not_equal_to: an active gate; objective_gate.enabled is false on v2 and v3 (F-078)
order block polarity before the flip

agree_choch.formula_ref: choch_value != 0 and sign(choch_value) == (+1 if side == 'long' else -1); rows with choch_basis == 'UNAVAILABLE_NO_PIPELINE_COLUMNS' are excluded from both cells
not_equal_to: a new BOS/CHoCH detection state machine

agree_eqh_eql.formula_ref: for long: eql_present and not eqh_present; for short: eqh_present and not eql_present (liquidity pool resting on the far side of the trade)

agree_pdh_pdl.formula_ref: for long: close nearer PDL than PDH (abs(pdl_distance) < abs(pdh_distance)); for short: the reverse. Both must be present.

agree_composite.formula_ref: majority (>= 6 of the 10 single-family predicates) agree for this side; ties are excluded from both cells

overlay_weight.formula_ref: w = 1+k if agree else 1-k; k = 0.5 FROZEN. Applied to STRATUM-CENTERED y within each crt_state_after stratum. Centering is load-bearing, not cosmetic: on raw y the delta reduces to k*stratum_mean*(n_agree-n_disagree)/n when the context carries no information, and with a base rate near -0.29R an information-free context with lopsided cells would score a spurious effect of roughly the size being looked for.

forbidden_aliases: session as any PRIMARY or stratum
hour_of_day as any PRIMARY or stratum
crt_state_resolved as the stratum (that is the RESOLVER, not the engine -- F-069, F-086)
{f}_window_truncated as an exclusion criterion (it is a warmup marker, True for all but the first ~100 bars; use {f}_age_bars against smc_window_len for boundary proximity)
{f}_distance == 0.0 read as 'zero distance' rather than 'no structure'
the composite family counted as an 11th independent discovery rather than 1 of 22 pre-registered tests

labels.y_definition: y = y_R_net from results/research/oracle_labels/XAUUSD_M15/labels.csv PRIMARY arm = multi_tp_walk (SEM-017) under the production two-target geometry (50% at TP1, stop reassigned to the half-way point, runner to TP2), net of ComponentCostModel (SEM-015, MEASURED XAUUSD broker) with AdverseFill (SEM-016) applied to stop exits. y_R_gross is carried alongside and reported, because a net figure on disp_bar geometry is cost-dominated by the tight stop and describes the geometry as much as the market (labeler.py's own caveat). NOT opportunities.rr_achieved. NOT clean_labels y_R_net (that bakes protocol 12bps, ~11x punitive per F-082 -- using it would confound exit kernel with cost model). SCHEMA NOTE: derivation_authority is declared 'forward_walk.other' because the FROZEN schema enum has no member for SEM-017 multi_tp_walk. The actual kernel is src/research/oracle/multi_tp_walk.py; 'forward_walk.intrabar_fixed' would be WRONG here (that is the comparability arm, and F-088 established the two are different trade objects).
labels.sign_convention: Positive delta_within_stratum means overweighting the agreeing side raises mean R-net RELATIVE to equal sizing, holding CRT state fixed. It does NOT mean E[y] > 0; the base rate on this population is negative (F-086: approximately -0.29R), so a positive delta can still describe losing less.

components.name: entry_slippage

components.name: stop_slippage

parameters.label: PRIMARY. F-088's naming trap is REPRODUCED, not fixed: partial_tp_breakeven_enabled does not do breakeven, trail_fraction 0.5 is a half-way trail, and the effective tie-break is SL-first via _intrabar_trigger_price rather than the declared TP2>SL>TP1 branch order.

comparability_arm.role: DECLARED, REPORTED, NEVER GATED. Run under the SAME SEM-015 measured cost as PRIMARY so the exit kernel is the only difference between the arms. Its purpose is comparability with the F-081..F-096 corpus, which was measured on the single-TP object; a disagreement between the arms is reported as a basis sensitivity, never resolved in favour of whichever is more favourable.
comparability_arm._note: Nested under exits.parameters rather than as a sibling key because measurement_contract.schema.json is FROZEN v1.0.0 with exits.additionalProperties=false. The schema is not loosened to fit an instance; the instance conforms.

parameters._schema_note: exit_family is declared 'intrabar_fixed_sl_tp' because the FROZEN schema enum has no member for production's actual trade object: two targets, a 50% partial at TP1, and the remainder run on a half-way trail. That absence is itself the F-088 observation -- the measurement vocabulary was written around a single-TP walk, which is exactly the object F-088 found every prior result had been measured on while production traded something else. The real geometry is fully specified in exit_model_id and the sibling parameters; nothing here is loosened to fit, and the schema is not edited to fit an instance.

exits.intrabar_rule: SL-first on same-bar ambiguity (multi_tp_walk._intrabar_trigger_price). Declared explicitly because F-088 established the declared branch order and the effective order differ.
not_equal_to: forward_walk single-TP (that is the declared COMPARABILITY arm, never the gate)

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Per family x direction, on HOLDOUT units only, ALL FOUR clauses: (1) holdout agree-cell n >= 30 AND disagree-cell n >= 30; (2) sign(holdout delta_within_stratum) == sign(train delta_within_stratum); (3) survives Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across all 22 pre-registered primary tests, with p from a block-permutation null (block=40 bars, n_perm=199); (4) |holdout delta_within_stratum| exceeds BOTH the long_only control and the shuffled-context control. PRIMARY is delta_within_stratum: the overlay is computed INSIDE each crt_state_after stratum on STRATUM-CENTERED y (each y minus its own stratum mean), strata where the context does not vary (all-agree or all-disagree) contribute nothing, and the surviving strata are aggregated size-weighted. Never delta_marginal. k=0.5 frozen. E>0 is deliberately NOT a clause: the base rate on this population is approximately -0.29R (F-086), so beating the base means losing less, not earning. If MORE than 6 of 22 pass, the set is reported as a suspected multiplicity artifact and NOT claimed. Meeting every clause is NOT economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false.
metrics.kill_criteria: Any outcome including n=0, n<30, or 0-of-22 is REGISTERED, not re-cut. INSUFFICIENT is an expected and legitimate result: F-086 measured the effective independent sample at 941 per direction (block autocorrelation +0.292 at lag 1 decaying to +0.003 by lag 20), NOT 47157, and 22 tests against that is not much power. Changing y, k, any agree predicate, the stratum variable, the holdout date, the embargo, the purge, the block length, or the permutation count AFTER seeing holdout y requires a NEW MC-* id. Adding a 12th family after seeing results requires a NEW MC-* id. Do not convert an overlay lift into a sizing rule. Do not present a diagnostic pass as G001. MULTIPLICITY MECHANISM (control is declared 'bh_fdr' because that is the closed enum member; the full pre-registered procedure is four-part): BH-FDR at q=0.10 over the 22 primary tests, p from a block-permutation null (block=40 bars, n_perm=199), PLUS train/holdout sign-match, PLUS a pass-count ceiling of 6 of 22. BH-FDR rather than Bonferroni: at an effective independent n of ~941 per direction, Bonferroni over 22 has essentially no power and would guarantee a vacuous null regardless of what is there. Block permutation rather than iid bootstrap because the label autocorrelation was MEASURED, not assumed. NOT GATED (reported only): sl_geom=fixed_atr; tie_break=optimistic; forward_walk intrabar_fixed comparability arm; delta_marginal.
